0.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_VANTHAU_000_000
0.description: You don't look ready to explore the churches... I-I won't take you until you are!
0.translation_description: Non sembri pronto a esplorare le chiese... N-non ti ci porterò finché non lo sarai!

7.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_START_MENU_ABOUT
7.translation_description: Scopri di più sulla Traversata del Pellegrino.

13.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_ENTER_FIXED_Q
13.description: Are you sure you wish to enter with a fixed party?
13.translation_description: Confermi l'ingresso con un gruppo prefissato?

14.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_ENTER_MATCHING_Q
14.description: Are you sure you wish to enter with a matched party?
14.translation_description: Confermi l'ingresso con un gruppo abbinato?

15.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_VANTHAU_000_010
15.description: B-By yourself!? Oh, <hex:021A020203>please<hex:021A020103> be careful...for all our sakes!
15.translation_description: D-Da solo!? Ti <hex:021A020203>prego<hex:021A020103>, fai attenzione... per il bene di tutti!

16.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_ENTER_SOLO
16.description: Are you sure you wish to enter alone?

24.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_ENTER_MENU_TITLE_EG_NORMAL
24.description: By invoking the Final Verse, you may challenge a simulacrum of the fiend lurking beyond traverse stone ninety-nine. What will you do?
24.translation_description: Attivando il Verso Finale, potrai affrontare un simulacro del demone in agguato oltre la pietra 99. Cosa vuoi fare?

25.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_SYSTEM_000_100
25.description: To consult the challenge log, you must first unlock it by completing the quest “Rising to the Challenge,” which can be undertaken by speaking with I'tolwann at the Drowning Wench in Limsa Lominsa.
25.translation_description: Per consultare il Registro delle Sfide devi prima sbloccarlo completando la missione «All’altezza della sfida», disponibile parlando con I’tolwann alla Dama Sommersa di Limsa Lominsa.

26.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_MIDDLE_TOP_MENU_NEXT
26.description: Proceed to the next traverse stone

27.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_MIDDLE_TOP_MENU_EXPLAIN
27.translation_description: Consulta le regole della Traversata del Pellegrino.

28.name: TEXT_CTSDDD4ENTRANCE_00942_MIDDLE_Q
28.description: Proceed to the next traverse stone with your current party?
28.translation_description: Vuoi procedere alla pietra successiva con il gruppo attuale?
